links.note: Doctors, nurses, teachers, lawyers and pilots providing their services to those who need them - this concept's list of tertiary activities.
Warehouses glossed as large buildings used for storing products before they are sold, used or rented out to shops - this concept's gloss.
The false pair puts a doctor in the primary sector; this concept lists doctors among the tertiary activities, which is what rules the option out.
Monetary value glossed as the value of something that can be measured in terms of money - this concept's gloss.
Ruling out steel manufacturing from a list of banking, transportation and healthcare is decided against this concept's account of the tertiary sector as services that support the other two.
Nandini from Karnataka - this concept's DON'T MISS OUT lists the other milk cooperatives, Nandini, Mother Dairy, Aavin, Vijaya, Kevi, Sudha and Verka, with their states.
Textbook production from wood pulp to printed book, which this concept says would not have been possible without all three sectors working together. Already linked and correct.
Recycling one tonne of paper saving 17 trees - this concept's DON'T MISS OUT figure.
Activities grouped into sectors because they share similar characteristics - this concept's basis for the classification. Already linked and correct.

Farming extracting against furniture-making processing - this concept draws that contrast directly, the product derived from a natural source against the product converted from one form into another. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.

The same extraction-against-processing contrast this concept draws in the AMUL story. Already linked and defensible, so left alone. Note: this item duplicates the preceding one and marks a different option as correct, contradicting its own answer text.
Earlier activities being agriculture, livestock rearing, production of tools, pottery and weaving cloth - this concept's list. Already linked and correct.
Recycling conserving trees and landfill space and taking 70 per cent less energy and water - both the assertion and the reason are this concept's figures. Already linked and correct.
Classifying activities to understand how they function and the links they have with each other - this concept's justification, word for word. Already linked and correct.
A factory processing what a farm grows - the same primary-to-secondary step this concept traces from milk to milk powder. Already linked and defensible, so left alone.
A teacher in a school as the tertiary example, against farming, manufacturing and mining - this concept lists teachers among those who provide services.
Services at hotels and restaurants - this concept names them among the tertiary sector examples.
The 2022 automobile table in this concept's DON'T MISS OUT lists passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, three wheelers and two wheelers, against which space rockets are the outsider.

Labelling each stage of textbook production primary, secondary or tertiary is verbatim this concept's LET'S EXPLORE, which is what makes printing-as-primary the wrong pair. Already linked and correct.
Catching fish from the sea as a primary activity - this concept lists fish from fisheries among the primary examples, each taking something out of the natural world. Already linked and correct.
